MERIAM AND THE HEAD NURSE IN CHARGE TODAY REALLY HAS PROVEN MY POINT. Thank you so much for the time and care that you took dealing with my German shepherd Kaiser. You made us all feel very cared for. Everything was explained in great detail and nothing was too much trouble. I was phoned by Julie to arrange Kaiser appointment for the following week within an hour of leaving the surgery. This is the sort of vets that we have been looking for and it was right on our doorstep. Thank you so much

I am deeply disappointed with the service provided by this veterinary practice. During my visit, it appeared that their primary focus was on maximizing profits rather than addressing my cat’s illness and pain. Despite my concerns, they refused to prescribe necessary pain relief for my pet. Additionally, I found the conduct of the veterinary surgeon, Anna Wybierska, to be unprofessional. She raised her voice and seemed unwilling to listen to my input regarding my cat’s condition. Based on this experience, I would not recommend Liverpool Street Vet and will not be returning.
